The main takeaway from our work is that

IRE selection of massive star-forming complex members is not a simple exercise, but rather requires a careful, multi-pronged approach that accounts for the unique characteristics of the individual target complexes.

, with sufficient care, IRE selection of massive YSOs can be a powerful tool in the study of star formation in the inner Galaxy, where X-ray observations are difficult and the field is crowded with contaminating sources.
